name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Keep home Live TV cards in poster format after EPG refreshes and contain artwork without cropping in browser and both TV profiles. Suppress mobile effects and Media Bar also with desktop layout on phone-sized screens.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
